Hextech MunitionsHextech Shrapnel Shells
@f4*100@% of Corki's basic attack damage is converted into magic damage.

The Package
After an initial @f3@ minutes, The Package arrives near the fountain. Once picked up, The Package lasts for up to 60 seconds, granting @f2@% out of combat Move Speed and upgrading Valkyrie into Special Delivery.

The Package reloads @f1@ minutes after being dropped off by Corki.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Corki's basic attacks deal bonus true damage to minions, monsters, and champions.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Corki's basic attacks deal additional <trueDamage>@Damage@ true damage</trueDamage> (does not affect structures).

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Missiles Fired @Stack@</titleLeft><mainText>Corki is building toward a Big One.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>
<titleLeft>Gatling Gun</titleLeft><mainText>Corki's gatling gun is firing at targets in front of him.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Corki's gatling gun rapidly fires in a cone in front of him, dealing damage and reducing enemy armor.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Corki's gatling gun fires in a cone in front of him for 4 seconds, dealing <physicalDamage>@TotalDamageTooltipOnly@ physical damage</physicalDamage> and <status>reducing @ArmorMod*-1@ armor</status> per second. The armor reduction stacks and lasts 2 seconds.</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Corki fires a flash bomb at a target location. This attack reveals non-stealthed units around the blast and champions for 6 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Deals <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage>  to enemies in a target area. In addition, the blast <status>Reveals</status> the area and champions hit by the blast for 6 seconds (does not reveal stealth).</mainText>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Corki fires a missile toward his target location that explodes on impact, dealing damage to enemies in an area. Corki stores one missile every 12 seconds up to 7 missiles total. Every 3rd missile will be a Big One, dealing extra damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Corki fires a missile toward his targeted location that will collide with the first enemy it hits. Each missile deals @TotalDamage@ magic damage in an area.

This Ability has 7 charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).

Every 3rd missile will be a Big One, dealing @TotalDamageBig@ magic damage instead.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Corki surges to target location, dropping bombs that create a trail of destruction for opponents who remain in the fire.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Corki surges to target location, dealing <magicDamage>@TotalDamage@ magic damage </magicDamage>per second to enemies in the fire left along his path.</mainText>
